purpose: Pure execution-scheduler core; not integrated, costed, or approved as an additional experiment arm.

selection_contract.entropy: Gaussian entropy with sample covariance plus epsilon*I for all seven normalized joint coordinates, plus Bernoulli gripper entropy.
selection_contract.binary_gripper: proposal[7] >= 0 means open; signs only affect entropy, original commands are executed unchanged.
selection_contract.normalization: (absolute_joint_target - current_measured_joint) / joint_scale_radians; one fixed scale shared by all joints and families.
selection_contract.entropy_horizon: max(2, first_argmax(diff(cumulative_mean_entropy)) + 1), matching the pinned author indexing.
selection_contract.movement: L2 normalized sample-zero endpoint displacement from measured joints, plus gripper_movement_weight if sample-zero gripper sign changed within the prefix.
selection_contract.movement_floor: First prefix k>=2 whose movement strictly exceeds the threshold; if none, use the available prefix length. Null threshold disables this floor for diagnostics.
selection_contract.horizon: max(entropy_horizon, movement_horizon), with singleton input returning one; no padding or grid quantization.
selection_contract.execution: Exact copy of sample zero up to selected horizon, preserving input dtype and values.
selection_contract.numerics: Float64 np.mean over each prefix and first np.argmax, without near-tie tolerance. Constant step entropy can produce nonconstant rounded prefix means, as in the pinned author implementation.

fidelity_limits: Joint-space adaptation, not reproduction of the original Cartesian-delta benchmark.
One seven-dimensional Gaussian replaces separate three-dimensional position and rotation Gaussians.
Joint endpoint displacement replaces summed Cartesian translation and composed rotation in the movement floor.
Scale 0.2 radians and movement threshold 1.0 are proposed engineering settings, not selected from results.
The shared sixteen-action prefix can truncate a longer native VLA prediction; no discarded tail enters decisions.
A singleton chunk executes one action, extending the undefined empty-argmax author case; at least two samples are required.
Upstream pi0.5 launch threshold four differs from paper appendix threshold three; neither is imported as a joint-space threshold.
No policy sampling, simulator integration, wall-time validation, or empirical safety claim is implemented here.

freeze_requirements.allowed_feasibility_data: Training/development-only cases predeclared by the main protocol; no reserved scenes or withheld family outcomes.
freeze_requirements.shared_parameters: One normalization, movement threshold, sample count, and covariance regularizer across all families.
required_accounting: independent proposal samples and RNG stream provenance
explicit protocol amendment and bounded budget before live evaluation
